about.en: RuneScape Gold (GP) is a Solana memecoin named after the gold pieces of the RuneScape game, an SPL token at mint HTmQz7My6MehV7bjhJ6jde8nDND1yvsz68d24LP7YgUQ. It is not an in-game currency, cannot be redeemed for RuneScape gold, and is not issued by the game's publisher Jagex; it is unrelated to Graphite Protocol (GP).
